parsed.name: PWM油门控制组件
parsed.description: 用于输出油门通道PWM信号的控制组件，常用于速度或推进功率控制。
parsed.description_en: A control component for throttle-channel PWM output, typically used for speed or propulsion power control.

actions.description_en: Update the PWM throttle control output.

actions.description: 以线程方式根据给定油门值输出对应的PWM脉冲，控制电机或车辆推进速度。
actions.description_en: Output the corresponding PWM pulse from the given throttle value in threaded mode to control motor or vehicle propulsion speed.

actions.description: 根据给定油门值输出对应的PWM脉冲，控制电机或车辆推进速度。
actions.description_en: Output the corresponding PWM pulse from the given throttle value to control motor or vehicle propulsion speed.

actions.description: 停止车辆并关闭油门输出。
actions.description_en: Stop the vehicle and shut down the throttle output.
